uno-turn.purpose: Active table turn status; smaller in compact layouts.

shadows.name: uno-card
shadows.purpose: Lifts physical card artwork above the table.

shadows.name: uno-recent-moves
shadows.purpose: Separates the expanded recent-moves list from the table.

motion.name: uno-card-lift
motion.purpose: Hover and focus lift; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: uno-card-flight
motion.purpose: Confirmed card travels from its player to the discard; skipped for reduced motion and initial or restored snapshots.

motion.name: uno-card-flight-ease
motion.purpose: Card travel decelerates into the discard pile.

components.name: UNO table primary action
components.description: Pale cyan primary action used only during active play.
components.css: .ds-table-primary { min-height:44px; padding:12px 18px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:#b6eaf7; color:#0b324c; font:600 13px/1.25 "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-table-primary:hover { background:#d8f6ff; } .ds-table-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c8f1ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: UNO lobby primary action
components.description: Existing lavender action for creating, joining, and starting a room.
components.css: .ds-lobby-primary { min-height:44px; padding:12px 18px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:#b4a7ff; color:#211936; font:600 13px/1.25 "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-lobby-primary:hover { background:#c9bfff; } .ds-lobby-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b4a7ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: UNO name field
components.description: Existing charcoal lobby field with a lavender caret and focus ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-name-label" for="ds-uno-name">Your name</label><input class="ds-name-field" id="ds-uno-name" placeholder="What should we call you?" />
components.css: .ds-name-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:#d5d1e2; font:500 12px "DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-name-field { height:46px; padding:0 12px; background:#111219; border:1px solid #3b394a; border-radius:7px; color:#f5f3fb; font:14px "DM Sans",sans-serif; caret-color:#b4a7ff; } .ds-name-field::placeholder { color:#a6a3b9; } .ds-name-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b4a7ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: UNO header navigation
components.description: Quiet text navigation on the active blue table.
components.html: GAME NIGHT
components.css: .ds-uno-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding:12px; background:#082a46; } .ds-uno-nav a { color:#c0d9e9; text-decoration:none; font:600 12px "Space Grotesk",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.025em; } .ds-uno-nav button { min-height:36px; padding:8px 0; border:0; background:transparent; color:#c0d9e9; font:12px "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-uno-nav a:hover, .ds-uno-nav button:hover { color:#f6f5fa; } .ds-uno-nav :is(a,button):focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c8f1ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: UNO playable card
components.description: White rim, dark inset border, and a light diamond beneath an outlined value.
components.css: .ds-hand-card { position:relative; width:108px; height:158px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:transparent; transform:translateY(-5px); transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-hand-card::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:-3px; border:2px solid #baf4df; border-radius:14px; pointer-events:none; } .ds-card-face { display:block; position:relative; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; container-type:inline-size; border-radius:9%; background:#039fd8; box-shadow:0 5px 9px #00132140; } .ds-card-rim { position:absolute; z-index:4; inset:0; border:3cqw solid #fffef5; border-radius:inherit; } .ds-card-frame { position:absolute; z-index:3; inset:3%; border:1.25cqw solid #13232e; border-radius:7%; } .ds-card-diamond { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; width:67cqw; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:3cqw; background:#fffef5; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-card-corner { position:absolute; left:10%; top:7%; color:#fffef5; font:700 26cqw/1 "Space Grotesk",sans-serif; -webkit-text-stroke:1cqw #13232e; paint-order:stroke fill; } .ds-card-bottom { left:auto; top:auto; right:10%; bottom:7%; transform:rotate(180deg); } .ds-card-value { position:absolute; inset:0; display:grid; place-items:center; color:#039fd8; font:700 79cqw/1 "Space Grotesk",sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.04em; -webkit-text-stroke:2cqw #13232e; paint-order:stroke fill; } .ds-hand-card:hover, .ds-hand-card:focus-visible { transform:translateY(-17px); } .ds-hand-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c8f1ff; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-hand-card:active { transform:translateY(-10px); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-hand-card { transition:none; } }

components.name: UNO current opponent
components.description: Compact opponent label with current-turn outline and an actual card count.
components.css: .ds-opponent { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:178px; min-height:50px; padding:7px 10px; border:1px solid #b8edfa; border-radius:12px; background:#174f6a; color:#f6f5fa; font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-opponent > div { flex:1; min-width:0; } .ds-opponent strong { display:block; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; } .ds-opponent span { display:block; margin-top:3px; color:#d2f5ff; font-size:11px; } .ds-opponent b { font-size:13px; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: UNO recent moves
components.description: Disclosure that opens the newest five real events above the table control.
components.css: .ds-history { position:relative; font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; } .ds-history summary { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:36px; padding:8px 0; list-style:none; color:#b2d2e5; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-history summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-history summary:hover { color:#f6f5fa; } .ds-history summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c8f1ff; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-history ol { position:absolute; bottom:38px; left:0; width:290px; margin:0; padding:10px 18px 10px 30px; border-radius:12px; background:#082a43; box-shadow:0 12px 32px #00122170; } .ds-history li { padding:8px 0; color:#d5e9f5; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; }

narrative.overview: The supplied blue card-table reference sets the active UNO game's visual direction. Opponents surround centered draw and discard piles. The local hand overlaps along the bottom. Keep the Deshi Tycoon design above and the charcoal UNO lobby unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: A blue playing surface with opponents in their seats.
Vivid physical cards with white rims and diamond centers.
Clear legal actions, named colors, and private hands.
